Order No.02 Dated- 10.11.2023 Heard the parties.

The petitioner has moved this Court for grant of privilege of regular bail in connection with Rajpur P.S. Case No.32 of 2023 (S.T. Case No. 378 of 2023 registered under sections 376 of the Indian Penal Code and under section 66/67 of the I.T. Act.
The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the allegation against the petitioner is that the co-accused person has made the photograph of the victim viral after committing rape upon her.
It is further submitted that the allegation against the petitioner are all false.

It is next submitted that during the trial, the victim has been examined, the copy of deposition of which has been annexed as annexure-2 at page no. 24-25 of the brief and she has not supported the case of the prosecution and has been declared hostile.
It is then submitted that the petitioner has been in custody since 12.05.2023 as has been mentioned in paragraph no. 05 of the bail application.
It is next submitted that the petitioner undertakes to cooperate with the trial of the case.
Hence, it is submitted that on the principle of parity, the petitioner be also admitted to bail.
The learned Addl. P.P. opposes the prayer for bail.
Considering the submissions of the counsels and the fact as discussed above, I am inclined to enlarge the above named petitioner on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/-

Case No. 378 of 2023 with the condition that the petitioner will cooperate with the trial of the case.
